title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via vm.runInNewContext (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, vm.runInNewContext turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The javascript-specific remedy is data-only handling via vm with a frozen context or no evaluation.
applicability: javascript codebases that build code or expressions from strings via vm.runInNewContext; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
